The audit output lists advisories for Pygments and Requests. The Requests advisory describes exposure only for applications that call `extract_zipped_paths()` directly. If you suspect a vulnerability in Rich itself, please use the private reporting contact in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
